investigation_notes.Alert Name: Trend Micro: Possible Data Encrypted for Impact
investigation_notes.Description: Ransomware indicators were detected on HOST-01, including a ransomware file and a ransom note with a heuristic suggesting data encryption for impact. The detected file path is C:\Data\Financials\2025\_RECOVER_INSTRUCTIONS.txt and the file hash is c17fe4a49e12034f44ad74793d520d17a1c6585bec5f3f03b5558da37a0b4617; the item has been quarantined. Given the ransomware indicators and presence in a financials directory, this represents a high risk event requiring ongoing triage and potential escalation, even though containment has been enacted.
